output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    WHERE o.is_revenue
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000
) AS c
output.explanation: Counts customers whose total net revenue from revenue orders (is_revenue), with an order date in 2025, is strictly above 50,000. "Revenue" is read as net_revenue, which excludes shipping fees, and amounts are assumed to be in EUR.
